title: [AI] Only show stacked bar tooltip truncation indicator when categories are hidden
issueTitle: [Bug]: Custom report widget of barchart mouseover legend is truncated incorrectly
why: Reproducing it needs spending in more than four categories across several months, plus a saved custom report added as a dashboard widget. You then have to hover over chart bars to see a tooltip, and the report never says what the tooltip should show, so there is no exact text to check.
